Priya —

Thanks for taking this through ACE. ClearSight (Evan Morales copied below) is ready to move to co-sell; they've completed the initial listing intake and asked for a PDM/PSM intro so we can align next steps (security checklist + marketplace listing timeline). High level:

- Product: ClearSight platform for real-time telemetry anomaly detection
- Ask: ACE registration + PDM/PSM pairing, help with listing requirements and opportunity qualification for a potential AWS co-sell early next quarter
- Initial signals: strong interest from two FSI pilot customers, procurement already engaged (procurement@clearsight.ai)

Karthik, Laura — can you join to align on who will be primary PDM/PSM and what pre-kickoff artifacts we need (intake, co-sell checklist, draft commercial brief)? Priya, what is the expected timeline from ACE registration to the PDM assignment on your side?

I'm attaching the fillsight intake they sent (small PDF) and a preliminary checklist that we can iterate on. Can we target a 30-min sync next week to triage and create a mutual action plan?

Thanks,
Soojin

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the intro and context. I reviewed the intake and this looks like a good fit for ACE. Quick notes:

- I'll register the AWS ACE intake today and request a PDM assignment; typical turnaround is 5–7 business days once intake is in the system.
- Can you confirm the estimated ARR band and whether there are any technical references we should include for the PDM?
- For co-sell enablement, we usually want the listing artifact + a short customer use-case one-pager. If you have a draft, please upload it to the HubSpot deal (link below).

I'll add the PDM once assigned and loop in the assigned rep. Evan — once Priya confirms the PDM, let's plan a 30-minute triage to confirm next steps and any gaps on compliance or procurement.

Best,
Priya

Thanks, all. A few quick clarifications from our side before the PDM triage: 

- Commercial: estimated first-year ARR target for co-sell motion is $180k–250k; we should aim to have a draft commercial brief before the PDM call. I'll take ownership of the brief and circulate a v1 by EOD Tue.
- Security/compliance: Laura, can you confirm whether the SOC2 docs and data residency notes are already in the intake? If not, let's flag for PDM.
- Proposed meeting slots for the triage (30m):
  • Wed 09/08 11:00–11:30 PT
  • Wed 09/08 14:00–14:30 PT
  • Thu 09/09 09:00–09:30 PT

I'll attach the proposal draft and a one-pager template for the PDM.

Please review the attached intake and proposal draft ahead of the triage — we proposed Wed 09/08 11:00 PT and Thu 09/09 09:00 PT as options; let us know which works. Agenda for the 30-min triage:

1) Confirm PDM/PSM owners and primary contacts
2) Review listing artifacts and gaps (SOC2, data residency, API keys/testing plan)
3) Agree on mutual action plan and next milestones (listing date target, co-sell plays)

Thanks — once we lock a time I'll send a calendar invite with pre-reads.

--
Soojin
